It then returns false when `enabled` is true, and also returns false on the fall-through. Every path returns false, so the feature flag has no effect. In ReadQuery, the QueryTypeSQL case therefore always returns "sqlExpressions is not implemented", even when the flag is turned on. I found no performance problem on the changed path.
